response.sql: WITH exam_patient AS (SELECT e.ID, e.`aCL IgM`, p.SEX FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) as mean_value FROM exam_patient WHERE `aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL), with_deviations AS (SELECT ep.ID, ep.SEX, ep.`aCL IgM`, ep.`aCL IgM` - om.mean_value as deviation FROM exam_patient ep CROSS JOIN overall_mean om), sex_avg_deviations AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) as sex_avg_deviation FROM with_deviations WHERE deviation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), with_sex_comparison AS (SELECT wd.ID, wd.SEX, wd.`aCL IgM`, wd.deviation, sad.sex_avg_deviation, wd.deviation - sad.sex_avg_deviation as above_sex_avg FROM with_deviations wd LEFT JOIN sex_avg_deviations sad ON wd.SEX <=> sad.SEX) SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, deviation, above_sex_avg FROM with_sex_comparison WHERE above_sex_avg > 0 ORDER BY above_sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10
